summary: Full audit of ETI Educom (Next.js 14 + FastAPI + Mongo). Created /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (103 pytest cases). Functional backend: 79/79 PASS (100%) — health, 24 public GETs, 13 lead POSTs, AI chat, admin password+TOTP 2FA login, 8 admin CRUD suites, 15 admin list endpoints, programs/SEO seeding, sitemap, upload. 24 deliberate authorization-hardening assertions FAIL, exposing a real unauthenticated-PII/unauthenticated-mutation vulnerability class. Frontend: all 28 public routes + 20 program pages + 20 brochure pages + programmatic /courses/<prog>-course-in-<city> pages return 200. 9 of 9 lead forms submit and redirect to /thank-you EXCEPT /franchise which returns 422 when the optional message box is left empty. Admin UI 2FA login works end-to-end and all 13 tabs load with 200s. Three endpoints are orphaned/mis-wired: /api/chat (AI chatbot has NO frontend UI at all), /api/quick-enquiry (no form writes to it), /api/cyber-warriors/register (CW form posts to /api/counselling-leads instead). Franchise leads have no admin view at all.

critical.issue: SECURITY: 14 lead/PII listing endpoints return 200 with full name+phone+email of every lead WITHOUT any Authorization header. Anyone who knows the URL can dump the entire CRM. /api/msg91-settings also exposes WhatsApp/MSG91 config. Add Depends(get_current_admin).

critical.endpoint: POST /api/educonnect/universities, POST /api/educonnect/programs, POST /api/announcements, POST /api/branches, POST /api/popup-modal, POST /api/seo, POST /api/technical-seo, POST /api/msg91-settings, PUT /api/founder-settings, POST /api/cyber-warriors/events, POST /api/cyber-warriors/video-reviews
critical.issue: SECURITY: 11 content-CREATE/UPDATE endpoints have no admin dependency. Verified live: POST /api/educonnect/universities?name=X with no token returned 200 and persisted the record. Allows anonymous content injection / defacement and overwriting SEO + MSG91 settings.

SECURITY: ~22 destructive DELETE/PUT endpoints accept requests with no token (returned 404 'not found' instead of 401 for a bogus id, proving auth is never checked). An attacker with a valid id can wipe every lead in the CRM.

422 when the optional 'Your Message' textarea is empty. FranchiseForm.jsx line 41 defaults why_franchise to 'Interested in franchise opportunity' (35 chars) but FranchiseEnquiryCreate.why_franchise has min_length=50. Any message shorter than 50 chars also 422s. Franchise leads are silently lost. Verified: empty message -> 422; 116-char message -> 200.

minor.issue: @limiter.limit('5/minute') keys on client IP. Behind the k8s ingress this can be a shared/NAT IP, so a handful of attempts locks out the real admin. The 2FA flow itself consumes 2 of the 5 attempts per login. Consider 10-15/minute or keying on a device id.
Accept data as QUERY PARAMETERS (name/logo/order) instead of a JSON body — inconsistent with every other endpoint, no Pydantic body validation, and puts content in access logs/URLs.

Cloudinary is blank so it correctly falls back to local disk (storage:'local', returns /api/uploads/<uuid>.png, verified servable 200). NOT BROKEN, but local files live in the container FS and will be lost on pod restart/redeploy — every admin-uploaded image (team photos, blog covers, partner logos) will 404 after a restart.
NOT CONFIGURED (MSG91 keys blank). Takes phone/name as query params; admin UI calls it correctly. Returns 200 no-op.
Partially configured: IndexNow succeeded (202); Google Indexing correctly reports {skipped:true, reason:'Google service account not configured'}. NOT BROKEN.

ui_bugs.issue: On the 422 above the form shows an EMPTY error element and stays on /franchise with no toast/message — the user gets zero feedback that submission failed.

MIS-WIRED: both the 'Individual' and 'Organization' registration tabs POST to /api/counselling-leads, not /api/cyber-warriors/register. Verified live (2 submissions -> POST counselling-leads 200). Consequence: the admin 'Cyber Warriors > Registrations' list is permanently empty and org/preferred-date fields are discarded.

No Franchise leads view anywhere. Zero occurrences of 'franchise' in the admin file; AllLeadsTab fetches only counselling/summer/industrial/contact/service-enquiry/quick-enquiry. Franchise enquiries are invisible to staff and excluded from the Dashboard 'Total Leads' count.

POST /api/chat works perfectly (verified: coherent Emergent-LLM career-counselling answer), but grep of app/ components/ lib/ finds ZERO references to /api/chat. The floating widget is only WhatsAppButton.jsx (aria-label 'Chat on WhatsApp' -> wa.me deep link). The AI chatbot has no UI and is unreachable by users.

The homepage 'Quick Enquiry' form posts to /api/counselling-leads, so its 'Interested In' program selection is stored as preferred_track and the lead is labelled 'Counselling'. /api/quick-enquiry has no writer in the whole frontend — the admin 'Quick Enquiry' source bucket will always be 0.

BROKEN IMAGES. Backend log floods with 'upstream image response failed ... 400' for hardcoded upload.wikimedia.org logos (Microsoft, Cisco, Adobe, IBM, Meta, Autodesk, Tally, QuickBooks, EC-Council). Wikimedia blocks Next/Image hotlinking. On /educonnect the 'PARTNERED WITH INDIA'S TOP UNIVERSITIES' strip renders as 9 blank white boxes.
Logo renders as a ~20px unreadable thumbnail on all pages. On /cyber-warriors TWO tiny logos render side by side (main + campaign lockup), looking like a rendering bug.

TESTABILITY: ContactForm, HeroForm, FranchiseForm, SummerTrainingForm, IndustrialTrainingForm, CyberWarriorsForm, ReferAndEarnClient, EduConnectLanding, ProgramEnquiryForm, HiringForm, CounsellingForm, JoinTeamClient, WarriorsAssessmentClient etc. have ZERO data-testid. Had to select by placeholder text. Only FreeCounsellingForm is properly instrumented. Admin panel has 14 testids for 2631 lines / 13 tabs (no tab, table-row, save, or delete testids outside Blogs).

integration_issues.flow: Cyber Warriors registration -> admin CW tab

integration_issues.issue: Tab fetches registrations/assessments/stats/video-reviews but never GETs /api/cyber-warriors/events, and there is no UI to create CW events — the review request expected an events sub-tab.

No tab exists for: Programs (/api/programs + seed-all), SEO settings (/api/seo, /api/seo/seed-all, /api/technical-seo, /api/admin/seo/ping), Branches (/api/branches), Announcements (/api/announcements), Popup Modal (/api/popup-modal), FAQs (/api/faqs), Jobs+Applications (/api/jobs, /api/applications), Authors (/api/authors), Founder settings (/api/founder-settings), Hire requests (/api/hire-requests), Brochure requests, Career-quiz leads. These are API-only and unmanageable by a non-technical admin.

CSP in next.config.js blocks its own analytics. script-src omits static.cloudflareinsights.com; connect-src omits https://www.google.com and https://stats.g.doubleclick.net, so every GA4 /g/collect beacon is refused. Console shows ~14 CSP errors per page load and GA4 conversion tracking silently does not work.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: ~47 mutating/PII endpoints lack `admin=Depends(get_current_admin)`. The admin panel's own JWT is therefore decorative for most of the surface. Prefer a router-level dependency (APIRouter(dependencies=[Depends(get_current_admin)])) for an /api/admin-scoped router rather than per-endpoint decoration, which is what caused the omissions.

FranchiseForm.jsx:41 — `why_franchise: formData.message || 'Interested in franchise opportunity'` (35 chars) can never satisfy backend min_length=50. Client and server contracts were never validated together.

CyberWarriorsForm.jsx:43 and HeroForm.jsx:27 both POST /api/counselling-leads: copy-paste of the counselling form. The dedicated /api/cyber-warriors/register and /api/quick-enquiry endpoints are dead code, and the CW admin tab can never populate.
/api/chat is fully implemented with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY and returns excellent answers, but zero frontend references exist — dead integration.

next.config.js CSP connect-src is missing the exact hosts GA4 beacons use (analytics.google.com is allowed via wildcard but www.google.com and stats.g.doubleclick.net are not), so the site's own analytics is self-blocked.
educonnect universities/programs endpoints take query params instead of JSON bodies — no request-body validation, and content ends up in URLs/logs.
server.py is 4781 lines and app/eti-manage-x9k2m/page.js is 2631 lines; both should be split by domain.
Local-disk upload fallback (storage:'local') is silently non-durable in a container — admin will lose all uploaded images on restart with no warning in the UI.

After the main agent adds auth, also re-verify the admin UI still works (adminFetch must send the bearer token on every one of those newly-protected routes — several tabs currently call plain fetch-equivalents that may not attach it).
rca_of_the_issue: Two root causes. (1) AUTH: get_current_admin was applied endpoint-by-endpoint as features were added, so ~47 endpoints added later (all lead GET listings, all DELETEs, educonnect/announcements/branches/popup/seo/msg91 writes) were never decorated. Proof: DELETE /api/contact/no-such-id with no Authorization header returns 404 (handler executed) instead of 401; POST /api/educonnect/universities?name=X with no token returned 200 and persisted. (2) FORM/API CONTRACT DRIFT: several React forms were cloned from FreeCounsellingForm without updating the endpoint or payload. FranchiseForm sends a 35-char why_franchise default against a min_length=50 validator (repro: /franchise, fill name/phone/email/city, leave message blank, submit -> POST /api/franchise-enquiry 422, empty error node, no toast; typing >=50 chars -> 200 + /thank-you). CyberWarriorsForm and HeroForm both still POST /api/counselling-leads (repro: submit either, observe network -> counselling-leads 200 while /api/cyber-warriors/registrations and /api/quick-enquiry stay empty). Mitigation: add a router-level admin dependency for the admin surface, and add contract tests that drive each form through the UI and assert the expected endpoint received the request (backend_test.py now covers the payload side).
